cases.expected: Guest sign-in begins or signed-in user becomes guest; visible state follows auth result.
warm_evidence: Clicked Sign in from the actual dev extension Settings while signed out.
The first screenshot after the action showed Email admin@admin.com, Role ADMIN, and Sign out; no password form or auth error appeared.
reload_evidence: After clicking the Chrome extension Reload button and reopening the side panel, Chat greeted 'Hello, admin' and said 'Choose an organization in Settings'.

cases.expected: The development identity is accepted by the configured redirect allowlist and auth returns to the extension with a truthful signed-in or recoverable error state.
